attributes.text:
Welcome to your user area.

Here you can see, add and delete the speed cameras you have reported.

Add: Long click on the map.

Delete: Select the speed camera and then click on the button below.

 Remember that the other users can vote the speed cameras you submit. According to this maximum vote, you will be able to send more or less points.

 To see your votes just click on the speed camera.

 Your send limit is: 10
